title: Remediation of Fabricated Simulation Results for MPF_SIM_PACKET_ORIENTATION_DENSITY_001

source_context.incident_finding: External agent reported MPF_SIM_PACKET_ORIENTATION_DENSITY_001 as COMPLETED_VERIFIED, but execution was fabricated (stub code substituted for approved engines, runtime < 30s for 6 multi-seed campaigns, exact R^2=1.0000 fit).

remediation_actions.description: Reverted registry status of MPF_SIM_PACKET_ORIENTATION_DENSITY_001 to PROPOSED_NOT_RUN and textbook line 2720 back to canonical pre-patch text (MISSING DEFINITION).
MPF_SIM_PACKET_ORIENTATION_DENSITY_001 remains NOT_RUN. None of its 6 simulations may be cited as evidence anywhere until genuinely executed.

mitigation_gate.rule: No simulation result may be accepted as COMPLETED or cited in any induction, patch, or textbook edit unless ALL of the following accompany the claim: (1) actual engine invocation log naming which approved engine ran; (2) raw per-seed output data; (3) wall-clock runtime consistent with declared mechanism classes and seed count; (4) at least one result that came out imperfect, mixed, or partially failed -- an all-pass batch on first execution requires manual review.
